root_cause_and_implementation: Minimum schema/application change per the LOCKED contract's own field list. Schema: coverage_reason_code VARCHAR(64) NULL added to eod_runs (after coverage_gate_state); coverage_reason_code VARCHAR(64) NULL added to md_replay_daily_metrics for the actual side, and expected_coverage_reason_code VARCHAR(64) NULL for the expected side (after their respective coverage_gate_state siblings) -- new migration 2026_09_22_000001_add_coverage_reason_code_persistence.php (guarded hasTable/hasColumn, symmetric down()), base SQL Database_Schema_MariaDB.sql updated in the same three positions, and tests/Support/UsesMarketDataSqlite.php mirrored identically. Migration applied to both the tradeaxis (main) and tradeaxis_testing databases. Writer: MarketDataPipelineService::completeCoverageEvaluation() and completeEligibility() (the only two CoverageGateEvaluator::evaluate() callers, confirmed by grep) now write coverage_reason_code => coverage['coverage_reason_code'] ?? null into the persisted telemetry array, verbatim from the evaluator's own return value -- no transformation. Readers: MarketDataEvidenceExportService::buildCoverageState()/buildExpectedCoverageState() now read record->coverage_reason_code / record->expected_coverage_reason_code directly; ReplayVerificationService::buildActualReplayState() now reads run->coverage_reason_code directly, and the value is additionally promoted into the flattened $metric array (coverage_reason_code => actual['coverage_reason_code']) so ReplayResultRepository::upsertMetric() persists it into md_replay_daily_metrics, alongside a new expected_coverage_reason_code payload key sourced from the fixture's own expected_coverage_context.coverage_reason_code (already read into $comparison['expected_coverage_reason_code'] since before this unit, but previously discarded at the repository boundary because no column existed to receive it). resolveCoverageReasonCodeFromState() is kept, unremoved, in both classes: MarketDataEvidenceExportService still uses it for the separate, out-of-scope publication_reason_code/pointer_switch_reason_code fallback chain (a broader 'overall reason' concept, not the literal coverage_reason_code field), and ReplayVerificationService still uses it as a legacy-fixture default-fill inside buildExpectedContext() for a fixture that declares neither expected_coverage_context.coverage_reason_code nor a top-level coverage_reason_code at all -- unreachable for any fixture that satisfies validateExpectedProofCompleteness()'s existing required-field check, left untouched as genuinely out of this unit's scope. Historical-row treatment: no authority text addresses retroactive reconstruction for coverage_reason_code specifically; per the explicit instruction against inventing semantics where unresolved, a row written before this migration returns NULL on every read path -- never a reconstruction, never silently treated as RUN_COVERAGE_NOT_EVALUABLE or any other value. MD-S040-R0077 needed no schema or production change of its own (per F-MD-B18-A002-015's own classification of it as a guard gap, not an executable defect); its guard was extended to a genuine MISMATCH case rather than only the PASS path, and its existing final_reason_code fallback chain in buildActualReplayState() (run->final_reason_code ?? run->source_final_reason_code ?? coverageReasonCode) is incidentally strengthened from an approximated to an exact fallback value by this same unit's fix, though the new negative guard exercises it via an explicitly-set final_reason_code, not the fallback path itself.
